text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, data cleaning, and dashboard/reporting work using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets.

I can build your list of 150 Home care services companies and organize the fields you need: decision maker LinkedIn, first and last name, company name, email, and phone number. I’m comfortable working carefully from defined criteria and cleaning the data so it’s ready to use.

A couple of relevant projects: for Marketing attribution analysis, I joined ad spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare credit models, which helped reallocate 18% of ad budget. For Shopify customer segments, I built customer segments from order exports in Google Sheets, and email revenue increased 19%.

If you’d like, I can start by clarifying the criteria and then build a clean, targeted prospect list.
